findings.finding: All unverified actual-looking institution identities and hours replaced by explicit generic fictional venue names/descriptions and null hours/addresses. Source city, scenario/location IDs, category grouping and original scenario types retained.
Park/Community Staff corrected to existing Park/Park Staff. No new categories or assets.

Nurse separates subjective symptoms from unmeasured temperature without diagnosis or triage guarantee. Government staff does not confirm submission or deadline extension. Police distinguishes found pouch from own carrying materials without property-rights determination. Postal staff does not assume authority over company mail. Bank does not claim postal address registration complete. Station does not certify the companion ticket valid. Supermarket uses fictional product-specific labels without certifying consumption safety.
